title: Siege of Jinju (1592)
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Siege of Jinju (1592)", at revision 1370742157, opens: "The first siege of Jinju was one of the major land battles during the Imjin War – the first occurred during the fall of 1592, and the second one in spring of 1593. The siege ended in a Korean victory and prevented the Japanese advance into Southwestern Korea. It was followed up by the second siege of Jinju the next year." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q14631695, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1592 Part of Japanese invasions of Korea". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
regionNote: Lane written by the Wikidata import (derived from its own point): this event points at no place record, so the timeline has nothing else to go on.
